gui.transparentae2.network_rendering.ena: Enabled for this ME network. Click to disable. Requires client and server rendering settings to be enabled.
gui.transparentae2.network_rendering.dis: Disabled for this ME network. Click to enable. Requires client and server rendering settings to be enabled.
config.transparentae2.enableTransferPath: Calculate ME network item transfer paths and send them to nearby players for animation. Disabling this stops path calculation for all networks.
config.transparentae2.renderTransferItem: Show moving items inside ME cables. Requires transfer paths to be enabled on the server and animations to be enabled for the ME network.
Animation speed in blocks per second. This only changes the visual animation speed.
config.transparentae2.maxTransfers.toolt: Maximum number of recent item transfer animations kept by the client. Lower values reduce rendering work on busy networks.
